name: marketing-os
description: Marketing OS — AI-powered multi-tenant marketing management platform.

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w web"
scripts.build: npm run prisma:verify && npm run build -w web && npm run build -w server
scripts.db:reset: prisma migrate reset --force && npm run db:seed
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w server && npm run typecheck -w web
scripts.verify: npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run build
